user.title: Add a MikroTik
user.description: A MikroTik router, switch or access point, over the RouterOS API (RouterOS 6 or 7). A user in a group with the read and api policies is enough.

data_description.ssl: Turn on the api-ssl service on the MikroTik for this.
data_description.port: Leave empty for the default: 8728, or 8729 with SSL.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: The MikroTik at {host} refuses the login.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect: {reason}. Is the api service (or api-ssl, with Use SSL) on, the port right, and is the address of Home Assistant allowed (IP → Services → api → Available From, and the firewall's input chain)?
error.invalid_auth: The user or password is wrong, or the user's group lacks the api policy.
error.unknown: Unexpected error: {reason}. See the Home Assistant log.

data_description.track_devices: A device tracker for every device this MikroTik knows from DHCP, ARP or Wi-Fi. On for your router; usually off for switches and access points (they still tell where devices plug in).
data_description.devices_enabled: Home Assistant leaves trackers of unknown devices disabled; this enables them.
data_description.consider_home: How long a device that is no longer seen still counts as home.
